records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Maya,

Thanks for setting up Maple Analytics on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Six days in with zero product activity: no project, no invite, no milestone, and no reply to the only outreach [email:f9374548]. No tickets or inbound signal of intent. Team plan and 8 days left leave some chance of a self-start, but silent accounts this far in rarely activate unaided.

draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Maya,

Checking in after your first week with Wrenfield at Maple Analytics. If it's been a busy one, no problem at all.

Two things that usually make the start easier: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time. If it's a larger group, teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through setting up your first project with you and answer anything else.

Best,
Chidi
